Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency profile. We had a quick internal conversation and want to accelerate a mid-quarter capacity increase: +35% committed tokens for the next 6 months while we launch a pilot. Two quick asks before we loop procurement formally:

2) If we commit now, can we co-term this increment to our existing annual contract end date (Nov 1)?

Samantha

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com; marcus_lin@redwood.com; jordan_blake@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Capacity increase request & co-term question

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and the doc, helpful context. High level answers up front:

- Billing: we can support either monthly true-up invoices (billed for actual consumption above baseline) or a staged voucher/credit approach (you pre-purchase an uplift bucket and we draw down).
- Co-terming: we can co-term the uplift to your Nov 1 renewal with a short amendment; the uplift will be prorated to the co-term date unless you prefer to annualize the uplift for a 12‑month commitment.

Two items I want to confirm before we put something in procurement: whether you prefer a refundable escape hatch (partial credit back if pilot < target) vs. an operational rollback (drop the uplift at co-term with no retro credit). Both are doable but have different pricing implications.

I'll draft two quick options for you (Voucher + Refundable Credit option; and Monthly True-up with No Refund) and loop legal and finance once you pick a direction. Ben and Marcus, tagging you for pricing & capacity checks — can we give Samantha an apples-to-apples comparison and proposed numbers by EOD?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com; marcus_lin@redwood.com; jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-04T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity increase request & co-term question

Olga / team — quick calc below for +35% uplift (6-month pilot) against ClearPath baseline: 

- Baseline committed tokens (annual run-rate converted to monthly) = 120M tokens/month
- +35% uplift = +42M tokens/month => ~252M tokens/month total during pilot

Pricing options (rough):
A) Monthly true-up: add pay-as-you-go above baseline at standard uplift tier price $0.0008/token (estimated) => ~$33.6k/month incremental charge; no prepayment; no refund terms.
B) Voucher/credit: pre-buy 252M * 6 months = 1.512B tokens. Offer 6% prepay discount + a 50% partial-refund clause if pilot <40% of ramped usage at co-term. Effective monthly cash flow smoother; revenue recognized per contract terms.

Operational constraints: we have capacity to absorb this in our NYC pool; margin impact is predictable under voucher model. Marcus — confirm GPUs and SLO for 35% bump is safe. Jordan — will procurement accept a 50% partial-refund or do we push a service-level rollback instead?

- Ben
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com; olga_petrov@redwood.com; jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-04T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity increase request & co-term question

Ben / team — infrastructure check: we can cover a 35% uplift in the NYC and use burst capacity from our reserved pool for the first 6 weeks if ramp is spiky. No change to latency SLO expected at the proposed ramp, provided ClearPath stays within the pre-agreed per-request concurrency limits.

I recommend voucher/credit for predictability. If procurement needs an escape hatch, a partial refund tied to clear usage thresholds is simplest for accounting. Suggest 50% refund if actual usage <40% of committed uplift over the 6-month pilot; else no refund. That keeps the customer protected while ensuring we don't hold unused capacity risk.

Marcus
Director, Serving Reliability | Redwood Inference
From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@clearpath.ai>
Cc: ClearPath Procurement <procurement@clearpath.ai>; ben_carter@redwood.com; marcus_lin@redwood.com; jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-04T16:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity increase request & co-term question

Samantha — thanks for the patience. Per internal check here are two succinct options (attached is a one-page amendment draft):

Option 1 — Voucher/credit (recommended for predictability):
- Prepay uplift bucket for 6 months (1.512B tokens) with a 6% prepayment discount.
- Usage draws down voucher; unused tokens are refundable at 50% of prepay price if total uplift utilization is <40% across the 6‑month pilot (the refund is issued at co-term).
- Co-term: uplift prorated to Nov 1; you can elect to annualize the uplift for 12 months at a blended rate (we'll provide the annualized number if you prefer).

Option 2 — Monthly true-up (recommended if you want cashflow flexibility):
- We bill for actual uplift usage monthly at standard uplift rates (no prepayment discount).
- No refund or credit; co-term prorate rules apply at contract end.

Next steps: if procurement prefers Option 1 we can share the attached amendment for redlines and route to Legal. If they prefer Option 2 we can issue a short SOW and configure billing. Happy to hop on a 30-min call this week to walk procurement through the numbers — propose Thu 10:00am PT.

Thanks,
Olga
